title: How to Reinstall Windows 10 without CD - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Reinstalling Windows 10 without a CD is a convenient solution for those who need to perform a clean installation but do not have access to a physical disc. Whether your system is running slowly, experiencing software issues, or you simply want a fresh start, reinstalling Windows 10 from a USB drive is an efficient and straightforward process. This article will walk you through the steps for Windows Installation without a CD, ensuring your system is up and running smoothly.

Table of Content

  • 1. Reset your PC and Reinstall Windows 10
  • 2. Windows 10 Reinstallation via ISO File on Your PC
  • 3. Restore the System Image and Reinstall Windows 10

How to Reinstall Windows 10 Without CD - 3 Methods

Windows installation is a crucial process, hence there is a need to follow the steps precisely. If you are also wondering how to reinstall Windows 10 without a CD from your current Windows version. here are three popular methods explained to you.

1. Reset your PC for Windows Installation

If you don’t have a system image stored, you can simply Reset your PC and Reinstall Windows 10. let's see how

Step 1: Go to Recovery

Type Recovery into the search bar & hit Enter. You'll now find the Settings page with the Recovery option will arrive. Click on the Get Started to proceed.

Step 2: Choose an Option to Proceed

Click on the Keep My Files option to get more options.

Step 3: Proceed to "Reset" your PC

Now click on the Reset button. It will help to remove all the installed applications from the device.

Hence, we have successfully reinstalled Windows 10 without a CD by resetting the device.

2. Reinstallation Windows 10 via ISO File on Your PC

When your PC experiences boot problems, you can resolve them by crafting Windows 10 installation media. Refreshing Windows 10 is easy when you have the ISO file already stored on your computer. This technique allows you to reinstall Window 10 without the need for additional external media such as CDs or DVDs, USB drives, SD cards.

Step 1: Visit the Microsoft Official Website

Browse the Official Webpage of Microsoft. and Click on the Download Tool Now button to get the .exe file.

Step 2: Accept Terms & Conditions

Open that downloaded file. Accept the terms & conditions.

Disclaimer: It is always advisable to read all the terms & conditions before accepting any document. In this case, also, read the terms before accepting. If you think, you might not move with those terms present there.

Step 3: Create Installation Media

Select the Create Installation Media ,and click on the Next Button.

Step 4: Choose Language

Tick mark the checkbox, It will fill up all the information as per the configuration of the device, and Click on the Next button.

Step 5: Choose Desired Media

Select the ISO file option to get that file downloaded. Then click on the Next button.

Step 6: Initiate the Download

After downloading process completion, the window for the installation will close automatically.

Step 7: Open ISO File

Now, find the setup.exe file inside the ISO file. Double-click on that to start the operation.

Step 8: Reset PC

Turn off your computer, and observe the installation status window. Wait a few hours. Your device will restart with the newly installed Windows.

Hence, we have successfully reinstalled Windows 10 without a CD by using the ISO file.

3. Restore the System Image and Reinstall Windows 10

Besides resetting, you can reinstall Windows 10 using a system image or restore point. Ensure you have a saved system image for this method to work without USB/CD.

Step 1: Go to System Settings

Go to the Start menu, and click on the system Settings on the left side.

Step 2: Open Update & Security

In the Settings window, select "Update & Security" and then click on "Recovery" in the left pane.

Step 3: Restart you PC

Click on the “Restart Now” button under the Advance setting option.

Step 4: Go to System Image Recovery

Now you can navigate to the “System Restore” or the “System Image Recovery” option if you have a system image or restore point stored.

In this way, you can easily restore and reinstall Windows 10 without CDs or USB drives.

Reinstalling Windows 10 without a CD or USB is possible. This article explains three popular methods to accomplish the same. Simply remember to back up your important files beforehand. If you lose your data, Recoverit Data Recovery is there to help you recover it.

Conclusion

Replacing Windows 10 without a CD is a feasible and reachable solution for anyone seeking to update their system. By utilizing a USB drive and adhering to the instructions provided in this article, you can carry out a thorough reinstallation of Windows 10 swiftly and effectively. This approach not only conserves time but also guarantees that your system is equipped with the newest version of Windows 10. Frequently reinstalling Windows can aid in preserving peak performance and addressing ongoing software problems.
